text: Focusing rewards on reputation rather than on immediately fungible cash encourages decentralized organization because it disperses power fairly: anyone with equivalent talent is equally acceptable, those already employed are unavailable, and the exponential rich-get-richer concentration of power is diminished.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Historical Sketches of Centralization vs. Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782193

isBasedOn.name: Historical Sketches of Centralization vs. Decentralization

abstract: Finally, a focus on reputation instead of immediately fungible cash rewards encour- ages decentralized organization because it disperses power, and it does so fairly.

value: networks that reward members with reputation rather than immediate cash
